---
title: DREAM Lab AI Gateway
---

::: {.callout-important}

This is an experimental service. We cannot guarantee its continue availability.

:::

DREAM Lab's AI gateway service provides API access to Large Language Models
(LLMs) hosted by campus cloud providers (currently, Google). It can be used in
conjunction with a coding agent or to build custom AI workflows. It does not
provide a "chat" interface. The service is primarily oriented toward DREAM Lab
workshop attendees, researchers learning AI-assisted coding, and Library staff. 

The OpenAI compatible API endpoint for the Gateway service is:

- `https://litellm.dreamlab.ucsb.edu/v1`

The Gateway supports access to the following Google models:

- [`gemini-3.8-flash`](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-3.8-flash): best for agentic coding
- [`gemini-3.5-flash-lite`](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-3.5-flash-lite): best for low-cost inference tasks
- [`gemini-embedding-2`](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-embedding-2): multimodal embedding model

## Creating an API Key

To use the AI Gateway, you first need to generate a personal API Key. Anyone
with a UCSB Net ID can create a key through the [API key
manager](https://litellm.dreamlab.ucsb.edu/dreamlab-keys). Please note the following restrictions:

- You may only have one active key at a time. If you "regenerate" a new key,
  your previous key is automatically disabled.
- Keys expire automatically after **three months**.
- Your key has a set budget that resets weekly or monthly. Use the key manager
  to see your available budget.
- The "spend" associated with your API key reflects the real cost of your API
  requests. Requests to more expensive models will will use more of your quota
  than requests to cheaper models.

## Data Privacy

The AI Gateway service **IS NOT** approved for use with data classified as
**P3** or **P4** under the [UC data protection
levels](https://it.ucsb.edu/security/compliance/uc-protection-levels). The
service uses models through Google's Gemini Enterprise Agent Plaftorm: Google
will not use data to train or fine-tune any AI/ML models, however they may
retain some data for limited periods of time for specific conditions, as
described in "[Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and zero data
retention](https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/resources/zero-data-retention)".

## Responsible Use

You are responsible for how you use this service and anything it generates.
Verify output before relying on it. Do not use it as a substitute for medical,
legal, or financial advice. Do not use it to produce content or take actions
that would violate law or University policy. As noted by the [UC AI
Council](https://ai.universityofcalifornia.edu/governance-transparency/), **if
an action wasn't permissible before AI, it isn't permissible with AI**.

- [UC Responsible AI Principles](https://ai.universityofcalifornia.edu/governance-transparency/)
- [UCSB's Guidelines for AI Use](https://cio.ucsb.edu/artificial-intelligence/ai-use-guidelines)
